title: Shizophrenia
body:
# Features
###   - Item loss ~ Every 30 seconds
    Removes 1-3 items from a random slot of your inventory when you aren't looking
###  - Item shuffle ~ Every 30 seconds
    Swaps two random slots of your inventory when you aren't looking
###  - Mob flicker ~ Every 60 seconds
    Spawns a mob for 3 ticks in your periferal vision
###  - Random damage ~ Every 60 seconds
    Deals half a heart of damage
###  - Mob sounds ~ Every 12 seconds
    Plays a hostile mob sound corresponding to your dimension
###  - Furnace theft ~ Every 30 seconds
    Removes 1-3 items from either slot of a furnace/blast furnace/smoker
###  - Portal unlight ~ Every 60 seconds
    Unlights your nether portal when you aren't looking and are far away
###  - Enderman aggro ~ Every 60 seconds
    Makes a nearby enderman aggresive towards you
###  - Durability drain ~ Every 30 seconds
    Drain durability from any items in you hotbar, offhand, or armor slots
###  - Unsafe bridging ~ Every 20 seconds
    Removes the block underneath you when bridging
###  - Hallucination Diamonds
    Turns nearby diamonds into glow lichen when you aren't looking
